method: Nationality: each host's primary nationality was read for every ledger row, matched by the host's own player id from the ledger: Transfermarkt's first listed citizenship on the 26/27 squad page, ESPN's citizenship on the club's 2026 roster feed, FotMob's country on the club's squad page. A nationality ships only where two hosts name the same one (nationalityHosts). Otherwise it is null, which nationalityOf already answers as unknown, never a guess from a name.
Spellings follow Transfermarkt, the house convention the nationality map and FlagImg already use; the other hosts' names are read through the alias table below.

Age is on the read date, 2026-10-06. Where the ledger carries a birth date two hosts agreed on, the age comes from it (ageHosts are the ledger's own birth date hosts). Where it does not, the age printed on the club's own player page and the age Transfermarkt prints beside the birth date must be the same number (ageSeen); the club page URLs are in clubPages.
Two ledger rows have no settled position group and no second age; the generator skips rows with no group, so neither ships.

sources.fotmob: each club ledger row's fotmob.com source URL (the club squad page)
